phrases.line: My pretty mouth will frame the phrases
stanza: I may be soft in your palm
But I'll soon grow hungry for a fight
And I will not let you win
My pretty mouth will frame the phrases
That will disprove your faith in man
So if you catch me trying to find my way into your heart

praises.line: They sing of all God's praises
stanza: I can hear the morning birds
So light up on the branches
They sing of all God's praises

praises.line: Give Jah the thanks and praises
praises.linePrev: Showed you I loved you, you called me a liar
praises.lineNext: I've been on my own, own, own
